primary_source_name: Tax Foundation: State Individual Income Tax Rates and Brackets (Jan) and Facts & Figures Table 11 (Apr); the later-dated table wins per state
rubric: Top marginal rate on wage (ordinary) income for a single filer, in percent. 0 for states with no wage income tax, including a tax on capital gains only (WA).
notes: Parsed from Tax Foundation's spreadsheets by etl/laws/sources/taxfoundation.py. Where the two tables differ, the note records the older figure (e.g. SC cut its top rate to 5.21% on 2026-03-30).

rubric: none = no tax on wage income (a capital-gains-only tax counts as none). flat = one rate. graduated = more than one bracket rate for a single filer.
notes: Info-only. The rate filter carries the ranking signal.

primary_source_url: VERIFY: state revenue dept retirement income guidance
rubric: none = SS, pensions and 401k/IRA withdrawals all untaxed. partial = some exempt or exempt below an income threshold. full = all taxed as ordinary income.
notes: Judgment call where thresholds apply. Not filled: no machine-readable source found that can be re-checked automatically, and values are never entered by hand (LAWS.md §8).

primary_source_name: Tax Foundation: State and Local Sales Tax Rates (midyear edition when published, else January)
rubric: State rate plus population-weighted average local rate.
notes: Parsed from the spreadsheet linked on the page. County override where local rates are known (not yet built).

primary_source_name: Tax Foundation: Facts & Figures Table 31, Sales Tax Treatment of Groceries (sourced to Bloomberg Tax and state statutes)
rubric: exempt = groceries not taxed by the state (includes states with no sales tax). reduced = a state rate on groceries below the general rate. taxed = groceries in the general sales tax base. Local grocery taxes are not counted. The reduced rate is recorded in notes.
notes: Table 31 includes California, Utah and Virginia's mandatory statewide local add-ons in the state rate. Replaced TaxJar 2026-09-27: TaxJar's page is prose, and aggregators disagreed on MS and AR.

primary_source_name: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year
rubric: COMPUTED, not hand-entered: ACS B25090_001E (aggregate real estate taxes paid) / B25082_001E (aggregate value), owner-occupied housing, x 100. Aggregates, not medians: the median-taxes variable B25103 is top-coded at $10,000+.
notes: Tier A. Built by the county ETL (etl/join.py) as the property_tax_effective_rate column of counties.json; state totals match Tax Foundation Facts & Figures Table 33 within 0.1 point. Never hand-edit.

primary_source_name: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Open Data API (electricity/retail-sales, residential)
rubric: Average residential retail price for the latest complete calendar year, cents per kWh.
notes: Tier A: fetched by etl/laws/sources/eia.py. Pairs with the rpp_utilities component already stored.

rubric: EFFECTIVE floor for non-tipped adult employees: max(state statutory rate, federal 7.25). States with no law or a sub-federal rate get 7.25 because FLSA-covered employers must pay it. Record the statutory rate in notes.
notes: The US DOL page is more official but blocks automated requests (HTTP 403), so it cannot be re-checked monthly; NCSL can. Regional rates (NY) use the statewide floor. A scheduled increase in NCSL's table that takes effect after the page's update date is applied on its date, with a note. County overrides for NY, OR, CA not yet built.

rubric: From NCSL's tables: recreational = comprehensive program with adult (non-medical) use allowed. medical = comprehensive medical program, no adult use. cbd_only = only in NCSL's low-THC/CBD program table. illegal = in neither table.
notes: UNORDERED — multi-select in UI, not lower/higher. Local opt-outs are common; a legal state can have counties with no dispensaries. Replaced DISA (a drug-testing company) 2026-09-27.

primary_source_name: KFF: Status of Abortion Bans (Abortion in the U.S. Dashboard), 'KFF analysis of state policies and court decisions'
rubric: From KFF's status categories: banned = 'Abortion banned'. restricted = a gestational limit at or before 12 weeks LMP. limited = a limit after 12 weeks but before viability (KFF's 15/18-22 week group). protected = 'at or near viability' or 'No gestational limits'. KFF's category text and notes are kept in notes.
notes: KFF's analysis includes court decisions, so injunctions are reflected. Parsed from the dataset behind the map (datawrapper chart Q43DW); the map's alt text can lag the data. Replaced the State Health Facts gestational-limits table (dated 2026-01-06) on 2026-09-27.

primary_source_name: Giffords Law Center (list of states not requiring a CCW permit), confirmed against Wikipedia 'Constitutional carry'
rubric: true if a permit is not required to carry a concealed handgun.
notes: Objective binary. The two sources sit on opposite sides of the issue and must agree, or the state is left blank. Replaced USCCA, which blocks automated requests.

primary_source_url: VERIFY: state department of education homeschool requirements page
rubric: low = notification only or nothing. moderate = notification plus testing OR portfolio review. high = notification, testing AND curriculum approval or teacher qualification.
notes: OUR rubric, not HSLDA's — they are an advocacy org. Not filled: no machine-readable source; HSLDA's categorization is an interactive map (LAWS.md §8).
